adaptix_statement: SigmaHQ master ships no rule mentioning Adaptix or AdaptixC2 at the checked commit.

generic_rule_results.title: Creation of WerFault.exe/Wer.dll in Unusual Folder
generic_rule_results.why: Sysmon EID 11 recorded the copied WerFault.exe outside all of the rule's known Windows directory filters.

generic_rule_results.title: Files With System Process Name In Unsuspected Locations
generic_rule_results.why: The same WerFault.exe file-create event matched the generic system-process-name selection and no filter.

generic_rule_results.title: System File Execution Location Anomaly
generic_rule_results.why: Sysmon EID 1 recorded WerFault.exe executing from the lab directory, outside all system-location filters.

generic_rule_results.title: Potential System DLL Sideloading From Non System Locations
generic_rule_results.why: The rule includes faultrep.dll and would match its non-system load, but the baseline intentionally disables high-volume Sysmon EID 7. No image-load event existed to evaluate.

generic_rule_results.title: Potentially Suspicious Malware Callback Communication
generic_rule_results.why: Ports 18081 and 18443 are absent from its port list, and the rule filters RFC1918 destinations in any event.

generic_rule_results.title: HackTool Service Registration or Execution
generic_rule_results.why: No service was installed or executed and none of its named service patterns appeared.

generic_rule_results.title: Suspicious Service Installation
generic_rule_results.why: Persistence was explicitly deferred; no EID 4697, 7045, or 7036 appeared in any captured run window.

hacktool_name_patterns.result: No filename or service-name hacktool pattern in upstream identified either renamed agent.

coverage_conclusion: Generic upstream coverage detected the signed-host location anomaly but not AdaptixC2's server body, default BeaconHTTP profile, periodicity, or TLS server identity. The new NSM rules target those gaps; the local faultrep file rule supplies file-event coverage where image-load telemetry is unavailable.
